articles.title: AI’s Frankenstein Moment
articles.summary: Experts are issuing ominous warnings about the threats of artificial intelligence. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei described possible scenarios of machine rebellion that seem straight out of science fiction. In his September essay “ We Must Pace the Frontier, ” he offered a plan for the outside monitoring of AI models and industry-wide and global regulation. articles.title: Russia Accuses Estonia of Hostilities ‘On the Verge of Triggering Open War’
articles.summary: Russia has accused Estonia of bringing the two countries to the brink of “open war.” The Russian foreign ministry on Monday lodged a formal protest with the Estonian charge d’affaires in Moscow over Estonia’s decision to close its road border crossings with Russia. articles.title: To Debate in 2028, Democrats Will Have to Disavow Dark Money
articles.summary: The Democratic National Committee (DNC) on Monday announced plans for 12 debates in the 2028 Democratic presidential primary, beginning in June 2027. The framework, released earlier than usual, includes a new requirement: To qualify for the debates, candidates must sign a pledge to denounce certain outside spending. Candidates will need to sign the newly released Fair Campaign Practices Pledge, denouncing both super PAC spending and “dark money,” which is any political funding from undisclosed sources. articles.title: What to Know About The Supermoon Appearing This Thanksgiving Week
articles.summary: There will be a lot of things competing for your attention this Thanksgiving week: the travel, the turkey , the family, the football. But spare a moment for the sky. On Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday, Nov. 23 to 25, a spectacular full moon known as a supermoon will shine overhead, visible both in the evening and, though not as dazzlingly, during the day.
